title: credential-leak-scanner: A multi-source passive credential exposure scanner with graceful API degradation
description: A Python CLI for defensive credential-exposure assessment that combines three passive sources: the HaveIBeenPwned Pwned Passwords k-anonymity API (no API key required), the HIBP breached-account lookup endpoint (key optional, gracefully skipped when absent), and a local CSV of synthetic breach records for cross-reference. Includes a Click CLI, an aggregation/risk-scoring layer, JSON reporting, an empirical eval harness that measures k-anonymity hit-rate and per-call latency on a labelled top-passwords test set, and an IEEE-style paper. Every external dependency degrades gracefully when keys are absent; nothing fabricates data.
